configuration_rationale: User raised the allowance to $3. Target approximately $2 actual spend with a strict $3 ceiling; use the largest output allowance fitting remaining dollars, up to 128000. Keep xhigh, frozen prompts, and all request settings otherwise unchanged. Disclose the actual per-request output allowances and any truncation.

rules: Anthropic cache counters are additional to input_tokens, not subsets.
Output usage includes hidden thinking; never add thinking tokens twice.
No-output refusals with empty content are unbilled except bio, frontier_llm and reasoning_extraction; mid-stream refusals are billed normally.
Interrupted streams have unknown final usage/cost, even when partial usage exists. Reserve their full possible charge.
Usage estimates exclude taxes, credits and invoice adjustments.

prompt_template.text:
You are an expert in Sanskrit grammar (vyakarana).

Derive the requested conjugated verb form from the Sanskrit verbal root (dhatu, given in
Devanagari in its Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included), its
verb class (gana), its traditional meaning (artha), and the required
tense/mood (lakara), voice (prayoga), person (purusha), and number (vacana).
Each Sanskrit grammatical term is glossed in parentheses in English.

Write ONLY the final form, in Devanagari script, inside exactly one
<answer></answer> block. If several forms are valid, give exactly one.
Do not include an explanation or any text outside the block:
<answer>Final form in Devanagari</answer>

=== Your task ===

dhatu (Sanskrit verbal root): {aupadeshika_deva}   (Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included)
gana (verb class): {gana} ({gana_en})
artha (traditional meaning): {artha_deva}
{prefixes_block}
Required form:
- lakara (tense/mood): {lakara} ({lakara_en})
- prayoga (voice): {prayoga} ({prayoga_en})
- purusha (person): {purusha} ({purusha_en})
- vacana (number): {vacana} ({vacana_en})

source_tasks.order: benchmark source row order; one selected attempt per task

adding case or number endings.

Use the displayed base with its stated grammatical interpretation. No specific
artha (meaning) is imposed: use a meaning under which this affix can apply.

<answer></answer> block. If several forms are valid, give exactly one.
Do not include an explanation or any text outside the block:
<answer>Final form in Devanagari</answer>

pratipadika (nominal base): {stem_deva}
base interpretation: {base_interpretation}
taddhita (technical affix): {suffix_deva} (SLP1: {suffix_id})
artha (meaning): unrestricted

sampling.method: Uniform sample without replacement from each 5000-task benchmark, excluding every task reserved in all prior wording experiments. Interleaved family order keeps a budget-limited prefix approximately balanced. No selection by previous correctness or refusal status.

budget_policy: Before each request, reserve its full actual output allowance and a conservative input estimate. In remaining_dollars mode, send sequentially and choose the largest allowance (up to 128000) fitting the remaining ceiling; stop around the $2 target, leaving roughly $1 headroom. Retain full reserves for unknown costs. No retries. Fixed mode uses its configured allowance unchanged.
evaluation: Exact accepted-answer membership; strict accuracy additionally requires precisely one answer block and no outside text. All requested tasks enter accuracy denominators, including refusals, incomplete responses and infrastructure failures.
scope: Frozen-template validation; never edit templates in response to these results. Fresh means unused in prompt experiments, not unseen in the original full benchmark. Report family-specific rates and intervals; zero observed refusals does not establish a zero population rate.
